name: "A Minecraft Server"
description: Welcome to Skemberdu, a dedicated survival and economy server built for pure, joyful gameplay! We offer full Java and Bedrock cross-play so you can play with friends on any device, completely free. Protect your builds effortlessly with GriefPrevention On, no stealing, just a friendly, welcoming community. We might not be a perfect or massive server, but we are passionate about creating a fun, safe, and relaxing place for everyone to play! Join in our discord server for updates!
